sentence: This project builds immunological assays that measure immune responses to gene therapies in mice and ferrets.
This project tries to find out which antibodies to Chlamydia trachomatis proteins could point to vaccine candidates against the infection.
This project tests a gene-editing strategy combined with a small molecule against neurodegeneration in familial dysautonomia.
This project studies why immune cells stop working in chronic infections and cancer, and whether a small non-coding RNA can overcome that exhaustion.
This project studies how social isolation during adolescence changes brain development and raises the risk of addiction-like behaviors.
This project looks for links between congenital anomalies and pediatric cancer using registry data and whole-genome sequencing data.
This project studies how many small molecules control an enzyme used in glycolysis in the cell.
This project studies how the spatial organization of reactions inside cells relates to their function, using biochemical assays and synthetic biology tools.
This project analyzes next generation sequencing data from cancer cells with computational methods.
This project sorts displaced amacrine cells in the mouse retina into types and studies how they divide up functions in different parts of the cells.
This project builds a genotyping assay that targets fetal cell-free DNA in maternal blood to assess preeclampsia risk.
This project tests a machine learning tool that summarizes a patient's medical history to help emergency department clinicians decide on treatment.
This project creates toxin-based vaccines that try to make the body produce antibodies against the fusion peptide region of HIV.
This project studies how an imbalance of hepatocyte nuclear receptor 4 alpha isoforms drives inflammatory bowel disease.
This project tries to find out why a class of drugs used to treat cancer harms the bone marrow and blood.
This project sets up a system for single-cell and spatial proteomic profiling to explore disease processes and developmental mechanisms.
This project develops statistical methods to study how brain cell types are affected in Alzheimer's disease using tissue data.
This project builds a software platform for trying out ideas that make mapping DNA and RNA reads to a reference genome faster.
This project builds a database of cancer mutations and evidence that helps doctors guide treatment of cancer patients.
